name: smith machine seated calf raise
description: A seated calf raise with the Smith bar resting across the thighs. It trains the calves.
instructions: Place a stable bench inside the Smith machine and sit with the bar padded across your thighs near the knees.
Keep the balls of your feet planted and slowly raise your heels.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels under control without rocking your torso.
